title: castilla elastica subsp. gummifera
intro: Castilla elastica subsp. gummifera, commonly known as the Mexican rubber tree or chicozapote, is a plant species belonging to the family Moraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Castilla elastica subsp. gummifera are attributed to its ability to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
